concepts.quote: for any 2-D array I need a[i].length
concepts.why: Contrasting a 3x3 board with 'any 2-D array' correctly relates rows being separate arrays that may have different lengths (ragged), though the reason is implicit rather than spelled out.

concepts.quote: For a 3 × 3 board I would use a[0].length, but for any 2-D array I need a[i].length
concepts.why: Correctly judges applicability beyond a fixed-size case: a[0].length only suffices for a rectangular board, while a[i].length follows each row's real size for a possibly ragged array.
Uses a[i] as row i of the 2-D array (a 1-D array with its own length field), relating indexing to the array-of-arrays structure, though only implicitly.
